story.title: UPS Small Business Rates: 2027 Next Day Air Early rates higher than 2026 guide
story.sum: UPS posted a 2027 Small Business Rates guide that replaces the 2026 guide effective January 26, 2026. Next Day Air Early rates are higher in every zone and weight shown, for example the zone 102 letter rate goes from $46.75 to $47.50 and the 35 lb zone 124 rate from $278.68 to $289.87. No effective date for the 2027 rates appears in the Next Day Air Early pages. The carrier's page doesn't state an effective date. This change was first seen on the carrier's own site on 2026-10-30, so it is treated as in effect from then.
story.plain: Small Business Rates accounts shipping Next Day Air Early will pay roughly 1.6% to 4% more per package on the rows compared. Increases are larger in dollars at higher weights and in the far zones.

story.title: UPS posts 2027 Small Business Hundredweight rates for Tiers 1-7, Alaska and Hawaii
story.sum: UPS posted a 2027 Small Business rate file for UPS Hundredweight Service covering Tiers 1-7, Alaska and Hawaii. It lists per-pound rates for the air services (Next Day Air, Next Day Air Saver, 2nd Day Air A.M., 2nd Day Air) and per-hundredweight-unit rates for 3 Day Select and Ground. UPS Ground Tier 1 zone 2 at 200-499 lbs is $44.85 and Tier 7 is $65.28. No effective date appears in the file. The carrier's page doesn't state an effective date. This change was first seen on the carrier's own site on 2026-10-30, so it is treated as in effect from then.
story.plain: Small businesses shipping heavy freight-style loads of 100+ lbs (air) or 200+ lbs (Ground, 3 Day Select) under the Hundredweight tiers will use these rates. Prices rise with tier, so Tier 7 Ground zone 2 at 200-499 lbs costs $20.43 per hundredweight unit more than Tier 1.

story.title: UPS posts revised 2027 value-added service and accessorial rates, effective Dec 21, 2026
story.sum: UPS posted a rate notice with new domestic and international value-added service and other charges effective December 21, 2026, compared with the rates in force through December 20, 2026. Nearly every accessorial rises, for example Additional Handling (weight, zone 2) goes from $46.50 to $50.50 and the Ground residential surcharge from $6.50 to $7.10. UPS My Choice for Business Reschedule Delivery moves from $0.00 to $9.99.

story.title: UPS Ship API EU PID guide now says Product Identifier fields are not yet in production
story.sum: UPS's EU Product Identifier developer guide previously said the PID fields were in the Ship API production environment. It now says they are "not yet available" there, with final production timing to come later. The ProductIDTypeCode field now lists a length of 4, and the sample request shows the exempt indicator as the string "false" instead of a boolean. No effective date is stated. The carrier's page doesn't state an effective date. This change was first seen on the carrier's own site on 2026-10-27, so it is treated as in effect from then.
story.plain: Developers and shippers integrating with UPS Ship API for non-EU-to-EU B2C sales should not expect to send PID data in production yet. No fees or prices are involved, and the field names and requirements are otherwise unchanged.

story.title: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026
story.sum: UPS posted a PDF with new fuel surcharge tables for U.S. Ground Domestic, UPS Ground Saver and Domestic Air, effective November 2, 2026. The Ground table runs from 28.50% ($5.53–$5.80 diesel) to 31.50% ($6.79–$6.88), and the Air table runs from 31.50% ($4.06–$4.11 jet fuel) to 34.50% ($4.66–$4.71). The out-of-range anchor prices rose from $4.99 to $5.80 for Ground and from $3.01 to $3.56 for Air, which shows the table was reset. Also: UPS announces U.S. Ground, Ground Saver and Domestic Air fuel surcharge changes Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Shippers using UPS Ground, Ground Saver or the Domestic Air services get a different surcharge percentage for any given fuel price from Nov 2, 2026. The size of the change per shipment can't be calculated because the old percentage rows are not in the supplied text.

story.title: UPS announces 5.9% average rate increase and new surcharges effective Dec 21, 2026
story.sum: UPS added a package-rate notice effective December 21, 2026. Daily Rates for Ground, Air and International rise an average net 5.9%. Area Surcharge and zone ZIP lists change, the Additional Handling minimum billable weight goes from 40 to 50 lbs., and a new origin-ZIP surcharge is coming for Ground and Ground Saver. Fuel surcharges for Ground, Ground Saver and Air will also change on November 2, 2026. Also: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Nearly all U.S. small-parcel shippers on UPS Ground, Air or International face higher base rates. Shippers with remote-area or reclassified ZIPs, Additional Handling packages, or qualifying origin ZIPs may see further cost changes. Actual impact depends on each shipper's agreement.

story.title: UPS announces Dec 21, 2026 rate increase, 50 lb Additional Handling threshold, ZIP changes
story.sum: UPS's Important Updates now say that, effective December 21, 2026, Daily Rates for Ground, Air and International services rise an average net 5.9%. The Additional Handling minimum billable weight goes from 40 to 50 lbs., and the Area Surcharge and zone ZIP lists change. Also new: an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers (December 21, 2026 or later) and a fuel surcharge change effective November 2, 2026. Also: UPS posts new Ground and Domestic Air fuel surcharge tables effective Nov 2, 2026.
story.plain: Shippers using UPS Ground, Air or International face an average net 5.9% rate increase. Actual cost depends on each shipper's agreement and profile. Shippers in affected ZIPs may see different Area Surcharges or zones, and Ground/Ground Saver shippers sending from certain origin ZIPs may pay an extra per-package surcharge.
